info.title: HC_RL_CreateItemFulfillment
info.description: Makes one item fulfillment for the order lines the OMS completed at one store, on one sales order. It is one line of a store fulfillment batch (HC_MR_RunBatchFile), or one call. Each line is found by custcol_hc_order_line_id on the sales order.

accountId.description: The NetSuite account: 9745435 is production, 9745435-sb1 is the sandbox.

get.description: Answers this OpenAPI file, the version deployed in this account.

post.summary: Fulfil store lines of a sales order
post.description: Steps: check the required fields; answer the fulfillment with the same externalId when there is one; read the sales order's lines by OMS line id; when every line asked for is already fulfilled, answer the fulfillment that shipped the first one, with existing true; refuse lines whose committed quantity is below what is asked; otherwise transform the sales order into a shipped fulfillment at locationId, receive only the open lines asked for, and save. Lines already fulfilled beside open ones count as done.

200.description: The fulfillment made, or the one that already shipped these lines.

400.description: The error, thrown with its name and message. Nothing is made.

externalId.description: The fulfillment's key, shared by every line of the order at that store.

locationId.description: The store's NetSuite location internal id.

omsOrderLineId.description: The OMS order item sequence id, as custcol_hc_order_line_id on the sales order line.

existing.description: true when nothing was made because the record was already there; false when this call made it.

code.description: The error's name: MISSING_FIELD, LINE_NOT_OPEN when a line is not on the sales order or not open, NO_STOCK when a line has less committed than asked, FULFILLMENT_NOT_FOUND, ORDER_CLOSED, or NetSuite's own.

message.description: NetSuite's SuiteScriptError as JSON text. Parse it for its name and message.
